effective_lease_rule: For ChatGPT workers, use the shorter of this rolling_lease_minutes and any longer lease advertised by an active review plan or translation epoch. Refresh only after durable checkpoint save.
released_claim_rule: A released claim is immediately takeover-eligible. The successor must atomically replace it using the current blob SHA, preserving the prior partial_result_path as handoff evidence before assigning a new claim_id.
partial_checkpoint_rule: Save a partial result after every checkpoint_every_decisions completed items or heartbeat_every_minutes, whichever comes first. Save result first, then refresh the claim.
maintenance_heartbeat_rule: A maintenance lease refresh is valid only after NEW durable progress evidence has been persisted since the previous claim write. A time-only heartbeat that merely changes heartbeat_at/lease_expires_at is forbidden.
maintenance_progress_evidence_rule: Every maintenance claim refresh must record a changed progress_token plus progress_kind/progress_ref that identifies durable GitHub evidence, such as a new maintenance-branch head, a changed persistent task checkpoint, a newly completed validation/sync run, or an orchestration-stage transition. The same progress_token may never be used to extend a lease twice.
maintenance_no_progress_rule: If there is no new durable progress evidence, do not refresh the lease. Continue read-only work only while the existing lease remains valid; at handoff release the claim, otherwise allow it to expire naturally so another worker can take over.
maintenance_finalizer_rule: Once domain content/research is complete, persist stage=ready_for_finalize and release the domain-work claim. The next owner claims stage=finalizing and performs only cleanup, integration, production sync/no-op proof, spot checks, and orchestration transition. It must not restart domain inventory or research unless finalization produces concrete evidence that domain work is incomplete.
session_end_rule: Start handoff by handoff_start_minutes. If incomplete, save partial result then mark only your own claim released with partial_result_path and completed_count. Do not intentionally leave an active claim at session end.
throughput_rule: A worker may claim another batch only before stop_new_batch_after_minutes. Prefer continuing from a released/expired partial batch over starting untouched work when both have similar priority.
